contract.consistency: One authoritative instance per backend. Committed seed/live rows must be visible to new autocommit reads. No replica/HA claim.
contract.atomicity: Single INSERT acknowledgements only. General COPY error atomicity, multi-key transactions and snapshot-isolation anomalies are not qualified.
contract.cedar_durability: Every Go connection sets and reads back async_commit=off. Native backup requires v2026-11-18. Process SIGKILL is tested separately from physical power loss.
contract.postgres_durability: Every Go connection sets and reads back synchronous_commit=on. Server fsync and full_page_writes remain enabled.
contract.restore: Require all seed rows and every ACK witnessed before backup invocation. Reconcile later ACKs separately as measured snapshot RPO. Restore a clone on new owned storage; never mutate the backup archive.

reference_client.tls: disabled on private lab network, not a production security configuration

contract.witness: Intent and outcome JSONL fsynced per operation outside database volumes. Failed/submitted outcomes remain ambiguous; reconnect never replays a mutation.
contract.limits: Single Docker host, no independent-host or power-loss proof. Fixed offered-load operational observations, not a capacity benchmark. verification.compression_scope: Off-path gzip level 1 calls only, excluding file reads/hash/fsync/body verification. Not native engine compression; native automatic codec CPU is not isolated from whole-container cost.

read_history.scope: Offline lower-bound check: latest ID must cover ACKs completed before read invocation. Actors share the Docker VM wall clock. This is not a general linearizability or SQL anomaly checker.

restore_summary.scope: Final source ACK population after live clone/read-only/full-body verification. Excluded later writes are snapshot RPO, not acknowledged loss from the running source.
